assertions.title: target_health_is_base_max_hp_percentage
assertions.statement: Target life progress uses a percentage of the target base maximum health.

assertions.title: any_uses_highest_realizable_condition
assertions.statement: ANY objectives use the highest realizable condition projection.

assertions.title: all_uses_bottleneck_condition
assertions.statement: ALL objectives use the lowest completion condition as the bottleneck.

assertions.title: threshold_damage_is_clamped
assertions.statement: Threshold objectives count damage only until the threshold.

assertions.title: overkill_is_explicit_discard
assertions.statement: Damage beyond a threshold is recorded as discarded overkill, not hidden in goal value.

assertions.title: first_victory_is_positive_terminal
assertions.statement: The first victory crossing contributes exactly the positive terminal value.

assertions.title: first_failure_is_negative_terminal
assertions.statement: The first failure crossing contributes exactly the negative terminal value.

assertions.title: draw_has_zero_terminal_delta
assertions.statement: A draw contributes zero terminal delta.

assertions.title: post_terminal_value_is_zero
assertions.statement: After the first terminal outcome, later life, resource, opportunity and DOT value are zero.

assertions.title: terminal_owner_is_unique
assertions.statement: The first terminal crossing has one causal owner and cannot be counted twice.

assertions.title: concrete_opportunity_is_real
assertions.statement: A CONCRETE_OPPORTUNITY is a real executable opportunity.

assertions.title: schedule_descriptor_is_not_response
assertions.statement: A SCHEDULE_DESCRIPTOR describes future work and is not itself a projected response.

assertions.title: projected_response_is_not_opportunity
assertions.statement: A PROJECTED_RESPONSE changes response probability only and cannot create a formal opportunity.

assertions.title: pass_is_active_choice
assertions.statement: PASS_OPPORTUNITY is an active decision to let a real opportunity pass.

assertions.title: lost_is_state_fact
assertions.statement: LOST_OPPORTUNITY records a prohibited or unavailable action and does not create a fake defense.

assertions.title: resource_order_is_total
assertions.statement: Resource facts are ordered by round, opportunity, action, phase, effect and event identity.

assertions.title: payment_is_fact_owned
assertions.statement: Payment and refund facts belong to the mechanical fact owner that produced them.

assertions.title: no_op_is_counterfactual
assertions.statement: NO_OP is a common scoring counterfactual and is not inserted into the legal candidate set.

assertions.title: control_loss_is_not_pass
assertions.statement: State-forbidden action is a lost opportunity, not a player-selected pass.

assertions.title: consumer_changes_resource_value
assertions.statement: A resource change matters only when an observable future consumer can use it.

assertions.title: all_legal_routes_enter_pool
assertions.statement: Every legal route enters the behavior pool before Pareto filtering.

assertions.title: affected_unit_closure_is_complete
assertions.statement: Behavior-pool invalidation includes every unit affected by a fact delta.

assertions.title: control_value_has_future_route_effect
assertions.statement: Control value includes its effect on future legal routes when a route changes.

assertions.title: defense_uses_actual_absorption
assertions.statement: Defense value uses actual prevented or absorbed damage rather than a label bonus.

assertions.title: evasion_uses_actual_probability
assertions.statement: Evasion value uses its actual hit probability and resulting route distribution.

assertions.title: counter_is_real_response
assertions.statement: Counter value is attached to the response fact that can actually occur.

assertions.title: support_value_has_consumer
assertions.statement: Support value requires an affected ally or future consumer.

assertions.title: healing_is_target_conditioned
assertions.statement: Healing value is conditioned on target life, threshold and terminal state.

assertions.title: repeated_effects_are_not_double_counted
assertions.statement: Repeated effects cannot count the same causal fact twice.

assertions.title: strategy_is_not_role_name_rule
assertions.statement: Strategy selection has no role-name or skill-name special case.

assertions.title: strategy_is_not_top_k_rule
assertions.statement: The legal pool is not reduced by an arbitrary Top-K cutoff.

assertions.title: belief_reads_public_hp_only
assertions.statement: Belief state can read public life ratios and public states.

assertions.title: hidden_hp_is_not_read
assertions.statement: Hidden exact life, resistance and inventory values are unavailable to the observer.

assertions.title: revealed_ability_is_public
assertions.statement: An ability is public only after it has been revealed by an accepted observation.

assertions.title: declaration_is_public_evidence
assertions.statement: A public declaration is available as an observation at decision time.

assertions.title: response_branch_cap_is_structural
assertions.statement: Response branches retain two public evidence branches and one catastrophic tail.

assertions.title: catastrophic_tail_is_not_hidden_plan
assertions.statement: The catastrophic tail represents public risk and does not disclose a hidden plan.

assertions.title: adaptive_value_uses_best_future_route
assertions.statement: Adaptive value sums outcome probability times the best legal future route for that outcome.

assertions.title: committed_value_uses_identity_intersection
assertions.statement: Committed value uses the best route whose identity is stable across all outcomes.

assertions.title: information_zero_at_exact_endpoints
assertions.statement: Information value is zero only when the relevant probability is exactly zero or one.

assertions.title: information_requires_route_change
assertions.statement: Information value is positive only when an observable result changes future route value.

assertions.title: dot_has_scheduled_window
assertions.statement: DOT value is limited to its scheduled effect window.

assertions.title: hot_has_scheduled_window
assertions.statement: HOT value is limited to its scheduled effect window.

assertions.title: delayed_effect_has_expiry
assertions.statement: Delayed effects expire at their declared expiry event.

assertions.title: summon_has_birth_event
assertions.statement: A summon enters the future pool only after its spawn event.

assertions.title: summon_stops_after_host_death
assertions.statement: A summon route stops when its host death rule is reached.

assertions.title: expired_effect_has_no_consumer
assertions.statement: An expired effect cannot be consumed by a later route.

assertions.title: creation_needs_consumer
assertions.statement: Creation value requires an eligible consumer within the remaining window.

assertions.title: item_value_is_inventory_fact
assertions.statement: Item value is based on actual inventory creation and consumption facts.

assertions.title: equipment_value_is_windowed
assertions.statement: Equipment value is conditioned on the active equipment window and consumer.

assertions.title: long_window_stops_at_terminal
assertions.statement: Long-window effects after the first terminal do not contribute value.

assertions.title: causal_state_owner_is_explicit
assertions.statement: State deltas have explicit STATE_DELTA ownership.

assertions.title: causal_action_pool_owner_is_explicit
assertions.statement: Future route deltas have explicit ACTION_POOL_DELTA ownership.

assertions.title: causal_terminal_owner_is_explicit
assertions.statement: First terminal crossings have explicit TERMINAL_DELTA ownership.

assertions.title: causal_sum_matches_goal
assertions.statement: The sum of causal facts equals goal utility within 1e-6.

assertions.title: pareto_has_six_dimensions
assertions.statement: Pareto uses exactly the six contracted dimensions.

assertions.title: hard_exclusions_precede_pareto
assertions.statement: Hard exclusions remove a candidate before Pareto comparison.

assertions.title: manual_lock_is_not_overridden
assertions.statement: A legal PLAYER_LOCKED action is executed even when AI ranking differs.

assertions.title: alternative_one_differs_structurally
assertions.statement: Alternative one differs by action, target set or payment mode.

assertions.title: alternative_two_maximizes_l1
assertions.statement: Alternative two maximizes normalized L1 distance among remaining Pareto candidates.

assertions.title: tie_break_uses_utf16_units
assertions.statement: Complete ties use candidateId UTF-16 code-unit order.
